 Advertisment Indian Markets Dabur India, Aurobindo Pharma and 6 Other Stocks That Will Trade Ex-Dividend of Up to 1,900% Next Week
 Eight stocks, including Dabur India, Aurobindo Pharma, HUL and Bayer CropScience, will trade ex-dividend next week, offering dividend payouts of upto 1,900 percent on their face value.
 by Sridhar J by Sridhar J 
 07 Nov 2026 19:00 IST
 Link copied! Copy failed! A dividend represents a share of a company’s profits distributed to its shareholders. When a company has retained earnings, management can decide to reinvest the funds to support business growth, repay debts, reserve them for future requirements, or distribute dividends.   So investing in these stocks can provide you with passive income and growth in your portfolio over time. Let’s see the stocks that will trade ex-dividend in the coming week. 
 Advertisment Dabur India Ltd 
 Dabur India Ltd is one of India's leading FMCG companies, specialising in Ayurvedic healthcare and natural consumer products. Its portfolio includes Chyawanprash, Dabur Honey, Dabur Amla, Vatika, Real and Dabur Red Toothpaste. The company operates across healthcare, personal care, home care, and food and beverages categories.

 The company is issuing an interim dividend of Rs. 3.50 per equity share, representing a 350 percent payout over the face value of Rs. 1.00  per share. The record date for the dividend is set as 10 November 2026, and the company has a dividend yield of 2.17 percent. 
 Advertisment Aurobindo Pharma Ltd 
 Aurobindo Pharma Ltd is a Hyderabad-based pharmaceutical company engaged in manufacturing active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and generic formulations. Its product portfolio covers antibiotics, cardiovascular medicines, anti-diabetics, gastroenterology, neurosciences, and anti-retroviral drugs. The company has a global presence, supplying pharmaceutical products across several international markets.  
 The company is issuing an interim dividend of Rs. 7.00 per equity share, representing a 700 percent payout over the face value of Rs. 1.0  per share. The record date for the dividend is set as 11 November 2026, and the company has a dividend yield of 0.38 percent. 
 Balkrishna Industries Ltd 
 Balkrishna Industries Ltd is engaged in manufacturing off-highway tyres under the BKT brand. Its products cater to specialised segments, including agriculture, mining, construction, industrial equipment, earthmoving, forestry and port operations. The company has a strong international presence, exporting its tyres to customers across multiple countries.  
 Advertisment The company is issuing an interim dividend of Rs. 4.00 per equity share, representing a 200 percent payout over the face value of Rs. 2.00  per share. The record date for the dividend is set as 11 November 2026, and the company has a dividend yield of 0.83 percent. 
 Galaxy Surfactants Ltd 
 Galaxy Surfactants Ltd is a leading manufacturer of performance surfactants and specialty ingredients used in home and personal care products. Its products find applications in shampoos, soaps, detergents, skincare, oral care, and cosmetics. The company supplies ingredients to several domestic and international FMCG brands and serves customers across global markets.  
 The company is issuing an interim dividend of Rs. 18.0 per equity share, representing a 180 percent payout over the face value of Rs. 10.0  per share. The record date for the dividend is set as 11 November 2026, and the company has a dividend yield of 1.03 percent. 
 Advertisment Also Read: Ramco Cements Q2: Net Profit Declines 47.7% YoY To ₹40.43 Cr On Higher Fuel Costs; Revenue Rises 10% 
 Bayer CropScience Ltd 
 Bayer CropScience Ltd operates in the agricultural solutions industry, offering crop protection products, seeds and related agricultural technologies. Its portfolio includes insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, and hybrid seeds designed to support farmers in improving crop productivity. The company also provides digital farming solutions and agricultural services across India.  
 The company is issuing an interim dividend of Rs. 90.0 per equity share, representing a 900 percent payout over the face value of Rs. 10.0  per share. The record date for the dividend is set as 12 November 2026, and the company has a dividend yield of 4.54 percent. 
 Hindustan Unilever Ltd 
 Hindustan Unilever Ltd is one of India's leading FMCG companies, operating across home care, beauty and personal care, and food categories. Its popular brands include Surf Excel, Lux, Dove, Lifebuoy, Vim, Pond's, Lakme and Horlicks. The company has an extensive distribution network, serving millions of households across India.  
 The company is issuing an interim dividend of Rs. 19.0 per equity share, representing a 1,900 percent payout over the face value of Rs. 1.00  per share. The record date for the dividend is set as 12 November 2026, and the company has a dividend yield of 2.07 percent. 
 Somany Ceramics Ltd 
 Somany Ceramics Ltd is an Indian building materials company engaged in manufacturing and trading ceramic wall and floor tiles, vitrified tiles, sanitaryware and bath fittings. Established in 1968, the company also offers tile adhesives, grouts, and other building solutions. It serves domestic and international markets across many countries. 
 The company is issuing an interim dividend of Rs. 6.00 per equity share, representing a 300 percent payout over the face value of Rs. 2.00 per share. The record date for the dividend is set for 13 November 2026, and the company has a dividend yield of 1.10 percent. 
 Emami Ltd 
 Emami Ltd is an Indian FMCG company engaged in manufacturing and marketing personal care and healthcare products. Its popular brands include Navratna, BoroPlus, Zandu, Kesh King, Dermicool and Smart And Handsome. The company has a diversified product portfolio and sells its products across domestic and international markets.

 The company is issuing an interim dividend of Rs. 5.00 per equity share, representing a 500 percent payout over the face value of Rs. 1.00 per share. The record date for the dividend is set for 13 November 2026, and the company has a dividend yield of 2.60 percent.
